text: Entry Requirements 18 to 35 years old. Students under 18 can also apply but they might need to find an adult(your family member, relatives or friends) living in China, better a Chinese, as your guarantor in China before you can apply, and your guarantor will need to provide related documents like guardian letter for you to support your application. High school graduate Chinese Language proficiency: HSK 4 (220)(* Applicants can apply one-year foundation course if their Chinese proficiency doesn't reach the requirements.
